objectives.description: Build web-based Workshop Management System for SG Garage

smart.specific: WMS with customer, vehicle, service, inventory, invoice, dashboard modules

objectives.description: Implement role-based access control for 3 user types

smart.specific: Service Advisor, Kasir, Kepala Bengkel roles

objectives.description: Migrate existing Google Sheets data to new system structure

inScope: Inventory management (stock in/out, low stock alert)
Invoice printing (PDF generation from service transaction)
Dashboard (daily revenue, active services, stock alerts)

deliverables: Training session for SG Garage team

tasks.title: Requirements Gathering
tasks.description: Review existing Google Sheets structure, confirm requirements with client
tasks.technicalReason: Need to understand existing data structure before redesigning

tasks.title: System Design & Architecture
tasks.description: Design database schema, API endpoints, UI wireframes
tasks.technicalReason: Architecture must be defined before development starts

tasks.title: UI/UX Wireframes
tasks.description: Create wireframes for all screens (dashboard, customer, vehicle, service, inventory, invoice)
tasks.technicalReason: Visual design helps client validate requirements

tasks.title: Database Restructuring
tasks.description: Restructure 6 Google Sheets tables, add relationships, add new tables for auth
tasks.technicalReason: Existing tables need normalization and relationship setup

tasks.title: Authentication System
tasks.description: Implement role-based auth (Service Advisor, Kasir, Kepala Bengkel) in Apps Script
tasks.technicalReason: Auth must be in place before building features that need role checks

tasks.title: Customer & Vehicle Management
tasks.description: CRUD operations for customers and vehicles, linked relationship
tasks.technicalReason: Core data entities needed before service transactions

tasks.title: Service Transaction System
tasks.description: Create, update, track service transactions with status workflow
tasks.technicalReason: Primary business logic of the WMS

tasks.title: Inventory Management
tasks.description: Stock in/out, low stock alerts, parts catalog
tasks.technicalReason: Needed for service transactions that use parts

tasks.title: Invoice & Dashboard
tasks.description: Invoice PDF generation, dashboard with KPIs
tasks.technicalReason: Output and reporting layer built on top of core data

tasks.title: Unit Testing
tasks.description: Test each module independently (customer, vehicle, service, inventory, invoice)
tasks.technicalReason: Verify each module works before integration testing

tasks.title: Integration Testing
tasks.description: Test end-to-end flows (customer → vehicle → service → invoice)

tasks.title: UAT
tasks.description: User Acceptance Testing with SG Garage team
tasks.technicalReason: Client must validate the system meets their needs

tasks.title: Production Deployment
tasks.description: Deploy Apps Script web app, configure access, migrate production data
tasks.technicalReason: Move from dev to production environment

tasks.title: Documentation & Training
tasks.description: Create user guide, API docs, conduct training session
tasks.technicalReason: Client team needs to be able to use and maintain the system

effortEstimation.timeline: 4 weeks (20 working days) - RISK: 24 dev-days > 20 calendar days

costEstimation.infrastructureCost: Rp 0 (Google Sheets + Apps Script free tier)

risks.description: Timeline risk: 24 dev-days vs 20 calendar days
risks.mitigation: Negotiate timeline extension to 5 weeks, or reduce scope (defer inventory to phase 2)
Ensure knowledge transfer docs, identify backup developer

risks.description: Google Sheets performance with growing data
risks.mitigation: Archive old data periodically, consider Cloud SQL migration in future

risks.description: Apps Script limitations (6 min execution timeout)

assumptions.description: Developer works full-time on this project (40 hrs/week)
Google Sheets structure is already finalized and won't change
No major scope changes during development
Client available for UAT within 1 day of request
Existing Google Sheets data is clean and accurate

Existing: 6 Google Sheets tables, basic Apps Script router, React Vite initialized
Core features: Customer, Vehicle, Service, Inventory, Invoice, Dashboard
fromClarification: Role-based auth needed (3 different access levels)
WhatsApp notification deferred to next phase
